response.justification: Bogdan has a robust technical background as a Staff/Senior Software Engineer with deep open-source involvement and architectural capabilities. However, he does not meet the core requirements for this executive-level Head of Development position. Most notably, his German proficiency is listed as basic (falling short of the mandatory C1 requirement), and his resume lacks the extensive formal team leadership, IT consulting, and project management experience necessary for the role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience developing modern software systems, including open-source projects.
Strong technical foundation in Linux environments and diverse programming languages.
Demonstrated ability to design architectures and build complex platforms from the ground up.
concerns: German language proficiency is basic, which does not meet the minimum C1 requirement.
Lacks executive-level leadership, formal team management, and IT consulting experience.
No explicit experience with formal UML modeling, enterprise IT security compliance, or risk management.
